name: beancount
description: Double-entry accounting as a derived artifact: build a Beancount journal from statement-extract JSONL, a category-rules CSV and a per-transaction decisions CSV — transfers paired through a clearing account (exact, fee band, FX, in-wallet conversion), statement and screen balances as assertions, loan snapshots with interest pads — written only when Beancount's own check passes. Plus bean-query recipes and Fava on demand, read-only, on 127.0.0.1.
